Scale-Space Localized Energy Inference

Source: R/scale_space_energy.R
scale_space_energy.Rd

Scans a statistic map across a prespecified Gaussian scale-space and controls FWER over scale, location, and statistic channel using synchronized null maps.

Usage

scale_space_energy(
  stat_vol = NULL,
  mask = NULL,
  scales = scale_space(c(6, 10, 14, 18, 24, 32, 48)),
  statistics = list(local_energy(), signed_coherence(tail = "two")),
  null_fun = NULL,
  null_spec = NULL,
  n_perm = NULL,
  studentize = TRUE,
  alpha = 0.05,
  seed = NULL,
  backend = c("grid_gaussian", "graph_heat")
)

Arguments

stat_vol

3D statistic map, or a null_spec when null_spec is not supplied separately.

mask

Optional logical analysis mask.

scales

A scale_space_spec object.

statistics

List of channel objects such as local_energy() and signed_coherence().

null_fun

Function function(b) returning a null statistic draw. It should be deterministic by index because calibration reuses draw b after estimating common observed-plus-null moments.

null_spec

Optional null_spec supplying stat_vol, mask, deterministic draw(b), and n_perm.

n_perm

Number of permutations/null draws.

studentize

Whether to studentize transformed fields using null mean and standard deviation estimated symmetrically from the observed map plus the null draws. Defaults to TRUE.

alpha

FWER level used for summaries.

seed

Optional random seed. Only meaningful when null_fun draws on the global RNG; the bundled make_null_fun_* helpers are deterministic by index and ignore this seed.

backend

Smoothing backend. "grid_gaussian" uses a separable, mask-normalized 3D Gaussian convolution. "graph_heat" uses a weighted 6-neighbor mask graph and applies the continuous-time heat operator expm(-t L) with t = sigma_mm^2 / 2.

Value

An object of class scale_space_energy_result.
